description: This file contains the implementation of a serializer and copier for multi-dimensional arrays in the Orleans serialization framework. It defines generic classes for serializing, deserializing, and deep copying multi-dimensional arrays of a specified element type.

classes.name: MultiDimensionalArrayCodec`1
classes.description: Serializer for multi-dimensional arrays of type `T`, managing serialization and deserialization processes including handling array shapes and element values.

classes.name: MultiDimensionalArrayCopier`1
classes.description: Copier for multi-dimensional arrays of type `T`, supporting deep copying with consideration for shallow copyable types.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes the multi-dimensional array to a buffer, writing array shape and element data.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes array data from a buffer, reconstructing the multi-dimensional array.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Checks if the provided type is an array (excluding single-dimensional arrays).

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs deep copying of multi-dimensional arrays, traversing all elements.
